entities.name: Emmanuel Maurice of Lorraine, Duke of Elbeuf
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Emmanuel Maurice de Lorraine was Duke of Elbeuf and Prince of Lorraine. He succeeded his older brother Henri (1661–1748) as duke. He died without any surviving issue.
